symptom: A navigation menu item cannot be given an icon at all — the grammar has no `ICON`, and every item mxcli writes gets `Icon: null`, so a menu authored in MDL is flat text next to one authored in Studio Pro
cause: The syntax was never added, and the reason it stayed unadded is instructive: the metamodel names the element `Pages$IconCollectionIcon`, but Mendix **stores** it as `Forms$IconCollectionIcon` — one more instance of the "Form was the original term for Page" rename CLAUDE.md documents for `ShowFormAction`. There was no way to know that from the metamodel alone, and inventing a `$Type` for a polymorphic child is the failure mode where mxbuild builds green and Studio Pro cannot open the document
file: `mdl/grammar/MDLParser.g4` (`navMenuItemDef`, both alternatives), `mdl/ast/ast_navigation.go`, `mdl/visitor/visitor_navigation.go` (positional `AllQualifiedName()` — the PAGE/MICROFLOW target and the icon share one indexed list), `mdl/types/navigation.go`, `mdl/executor/cmd_navigation.go` (`convertMenuItemDef`, `printMenuMDL`), `sdk/mpr/writer_navigation.go` (`buildMenuIconBson`), `mdl/backend/modelsdk/navigation_write.go`, `sdk/mpr/parser_misc.go`, `mdl/backend/mpr/convert.go` (`convertNavMenuItem` is a field-by-field copy and drops anything new)
insight: **The icon is a `qualifiedName`, not a string** — it is a reference into the model, so it is spelled like every other reference (ADR-0003). Atlas names are hyphenated, and `align-center` lexes as HYPHENATED_ID, so that *segment* is double-quoted: `ICON Atlas_Core.Atlas."align-center"`. The DESCRIBE emitter (`quoteQualifiedName` in `mdl/executor/qualified_name_quoting.go`) must therefore decide quoting per segment, and **must not reuse `mdlIdent`**: mdlIdent quotes anything not lexing as a bare IDENTIFIER, but a qualifiedName segment is an `identifierOrKeyword`, which accepts keywords — and `home`, `user`, `add`, `folder` are all keyword tokens, so mdlIdent would quote nearly every icon. Decide acceptance by running the real parser on the segment, never a hardcoded keyword list. The invariant worth testing is not "which names get quotes" (I guessed that wrong twice) but **"does the emitted statement re-parse"** — feed DESCRIBE output back through `visitor.Build`. **Get the reference before writing the BSON.** A Studio Pro-authored project (`ako/mxcli-ledger`) settled in one dump what no amount of metamodel reading could: the storage name, the field (`Image`, a 3-part `Module.Collection.name`), the exact key set (`$ID`/`$Type`/`Image`, nothing more), and that **all three variants coexist** — `Forms$IconCollectionIcon{Image}`, `Forms$ImageIcon{Image}` (indistinguishable by name alone; it points into an *image* collection), `Forms$GlyphIcon{Code: int}`. Only the first is written; DESCRIBE emits a `-- icon … is not reproducible` comment for the other two rather than an `icon` clause that would convert the variant on replay. To dump a v2 unit: `grep -rl 'Menus$MenuItem' mprcontents` then `bson.Unmarshal` into a `bson.D`. **`mx check` reporting 0 errors is not the proof here** — its deserializer tolerates unknown properties; the proof is diffing the written element against the Studio Pro one (done: byte-shape identical, same key order). Icon *names* are also not guessable — `Atlas.list` and `Atlas_Filled.user-check` do not exist while `list-bullets` and `user` do; verify against the collection. **Second trap, in the read path**: `codec.Decode` returns a bare `*element.Base` for an *unregistered* `$Type` but a generated struct (which only *embeds* Base) for a registered one, so `icon.(*element.Base)` silently returns nothing for exactly the variants that exist in real projects — DESCRIBE printed every icon under `legacy` and none under `modelsdk`. Assert on `interface{ Raw() bson.Raw }`, which both shapes satisfy. A unit test passing `nil` did not reach this; **running `describe` against a real Studio Pro project under both `MXCLI_ENGINE` values did**, and that engine-vs-engine diff is the cheapest way to find a read-path divergence. Note `modelsdk/codec` is on bson **v2** while `mdl/backend/modelsdk`'s write path is on v1 — a test touching both needs an alias. Tests `sdk/mpr/writer_navigation_icon_test.go`, `mdl/visitor/visitor_navigation_icon_test.go`, `mdl/executor/cmd_navigation_icon_test.go`, `mdl/backend/modelsdk/navigation_icon_test.go`; example `mdl-examples/doctype-tests/11-navigation-examples.mdl`. mxcli-formula1 #9
